'''Klikk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He had extensive experience with the technical aspects of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including their features, how to repair them, and how to reassemble them.
